usage: deskops add ritual [-h] [--root ROOT] [--from-yaml FROM_YAML]
                          [--title TITLE] [--summary SUMMARY]
                          [--tags TAGS [TAGS ...]] --purpose PURPOSE
                          --trigger TRIGGER
                          [--preconditions PRECONDITIONS [PRECONDITIONS ...]]
                          [--steps STEPS [STEPS ...]]
                          [--validation VALIDATION [VALIDATION ...]]
                          [--failure-modes FAILURE_MODES [FAILURE_MODES ...]]
                          --completion COMPLETION

Create a ritual artifact.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
  --from-yaml FROM_YAML
                        Load the ritual payload from a YAML file.
  --title TITLE         Short ritual title.
  --summary SUMMARY     Short semantic summary for the primitive.
  --tags TAGS [TAGS ...]
                        Semantic tags placed at the end, using namespaced forms such as 'layer:workflow' or 'system:sldb'.
  --purpose PURPOSE     Why the ritual exists.
  --trigger TRIGGER     When the ritual should be started.
  --preconditions PRECONDITIONS [PRECONDITIONS ...]
                        Conditions that must hold before running the ritual.
  --steps STEPS [STEPS ...]
                        Ordered steps to execute as part of the ritual.
  --validation VALIDATION [VALIDATION ...]
                        Checks that confirm the ritual was performed correctly.
  --failure-modes FAILURE_MODES [FAILURE_MODES ...]
                        Common mistakes, drifts, or anti-patterns to avoid.
  --completion COMPLETION
                        What indicates that the ritual has been completed.

Example:
  deskops add ritual --root . --title "Example"
